item.title: ARP への別れ: IPv6 専用ネットワーク上の IPv4 サービス
item.description:

🔤 Original: A Farewell to ARPs: IPv4 Service on IPv6-Only Networks
🔗 Read more: https://labs.ripe.net/author/remco-van-mook/a-farewell-to-arps-ipv4-service-on-ipv6-only-networks/
